Subject: Azure marketplace retrocharge + withholding — need collection path

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note from our finance team — we found a number of February charges (Invoice 4312) that were retrocharged by Azure after our books were closed. Because those lines were billed under a different seller entity, Azure applied a 10% withholding and flagged the payout for review. We need Redwood to supply:

- a short reconciled ledger that maps the retrocharged usage lines to your seller entity IDs
- VAT evidence that supports pass-through (we bill end-customer VAT, and need to avoid duplicate VAT holds)
- a contact at Redwood who will coordinate payout release with Microsoft (we're getting asked for a technical contact)

I attached the invoice and evidence bundle we have so far. Can we get an owner and an ETA on the packet? The payout hold is blocking our month-end close.

Thanks,
Tom Hannan
Director, Finance — NimbleCloud Ltd

Tom —

Attached is the reconciliation packet we submitted to Azure support case CAS-59231 (link below). Summary:

- Marissa mapped 84 lines to correct seller_9041; total net retrocharge = EUR 42,112.50.
- Jonas attached VAT mapping and Nimble's signed VAT declaration; this supports a pass-through (no duplicate VAT charge).
- Proposed remediation: Azure releases the withheld amount to seller_9041 and issues a marketplace credit to compensate for the payout timing impact if they decline direct reroute.

Requested actions for Nimble:
1) Confirm preference: direct payout to seller_9041 OR credit memo to your billing account. Reply with chosen option.
2) If you choose direct payout, confirm bank instructions are unchanged.

Azure support (mp-support) — can you confirm receipt of CAS-59231 and advise expected SLA for releasing holds once packet is validated?

Tom — we'll keep pushing, but please reply with item (1) so we can close the loop with Microsoft.
